Welcome to No Name

A café, a kitchen & a loft in the trees

Cafe No Name is a café, restaurant and hostel on Passara Road in Ella — healthy Sri Lankan food, vegetarian and vegan options, fresh juices and cocktails, and beds in a timber loft and tents above the valley.

Host Sanjeeva and the team run a cooking class, help plan your travels, and keep the kitchen open from breakfast to late. Cash only · free parking.

The hostel

Sleep in the loft or a tent

Upstairs, a timber loft strung with bulbs and hammocks; out on the deck, tents looking over the jungle valley. Simple, social and a short walk from Ella town.
